messages:
Maria (CS): Final prep for Papertrail reserved bring-up next Tue 2026-04-08 21:00 UTC. Need: quota sign-off, autoscale policy confirmation, short load test runbook, and customer visibility plan. Who can own each?
AJ (Ops): Ill own ops. Customer requested 4 reserved A100 nodes with burst to 8. Region quota check: looks clear but will re-verify with infra.
Oliver (SE): Pool will serve model v2.3-quant; recommend target_batch 32, allow_burst_batches up to 64. I'll bake warm-cache script for prefix-heavy queries.
Nina (SRE): Recommend 20-30m pre-warm synthetic traces to populate KV prefixes. Autoscale: scale-up at 70% GPU util sustained 60s, scale-down at 35% below 300s. Add guardrails to avoid oscillation.
Devon (AM): I'll handle customer comms and renewal touchpoint. Goal: show stable p95 <= 220ms and error rate < 0.2% during soak.
AJ (Ops): Proposed runbook: 1) Reserve nodes + deploy variant 2) 30m warmup (papertrail-traces.json) 3) Ramp to 70% target QPS for 15m 4) 20m soak at target QPS 5) Observe then cut-over. Load command: ./loadtest --target papertrail --rps 650 --concurrency 120 --duration 35m --traces papertrail-traces.json
Maria (CS): Devon - please confirm acceptance criteria we share with customer and collect written quota sign-off so finance can invoice correctly.
Devon (AM): Acceptance: p95 latency < 220ms; error rate < 0.1% sustained; token cost within +/-8% of estimate. I'll get a brief email sign-off after run. Also will invite them to last 10m of soak for live dashboard view.
Oliver (SE): Note: long sequences sometimes hit quantization fallback. Adding a 2k-token test case to traces. Also enabling partial_kv_cache and dynamic batching in config: batching.target=32 batching.max_delay_ms=6 caching.kv_prefetch=true
Nina (SRE): I'll create an incident stub for the window and set pager threshold: >0.5% error spike over 5m. I'll also pre-create dashboard snapshots and links for customer view.
AJ (Ops): I'll run a dry-run tomorrow at 18:00 UTC using the same traces to validate autoscale behavior. If dry-run passes, we proceed on Tue. Dry-run notes will be posted to ops-runbook channel.
Runbook Bot: reserved-pool "papertrail-reserved" -> resized to 6 nodes (4 reserved + 2 buffer) at 2026-04-07T18:02:12Z
Maria (CS): Feedback capture: post-soak we'll send a 2-question survey and include a 3-point handover checklist: "handover clarity", "latency satisfaction", "any anomalies seen". I'll attach to the customer note.
Devon (AM): I'll also request their projected usage for next quarter to realign commit/billing.
Oliver (SE): Sharing staging config diff in 5m. Will include the long-sequence test cases.
Nina (SRE): Acknowledged. Owners: AJ=ops lead, Oliver=SE config, Nina=SRE monitoring, Devon=account/renewal, Maria=customer comms. Any blockers?
AJ (Ops): None. I'll confirm dry-run outcomes.
Devon (AM): All set on my side.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll post a short customer-facing schedule after the dry-run.
